_note: Hand-curated campaign promises and the record against them. kind 'explicit' = his own words in 2024; 'record' = implied by the record his 2024 site ran on, not a stated pledge. Actions: 'roll' fills his vote and the tally from data/votes.json; 'stmt' must match exactly one release in data/statements.json; 'u' is any other source. Status is an editorial call: 'why' must say what it rests on. Build: python3 -I scripts/build_promises.py

promises.promise: fight for a nationwide $15 minimum wage

actions.text: Cosponsored the Raise the Wage Act of 2025 (H.R. 2743), introduced Apr 8, 2025.

promises.why: He cosponsored the bill, but congress.gov shows it was only referred to committee.

promises.promise: the best approach to fixing our healthcare system is passing Medicare for All

actions.text: Cosponsored the Medicare for All Act (H.R. 3069), introduced Apr 29, 2025.

promises.why: He cosponsored the bill, but it was only referred to committee.

promises.promise: I support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act

actions.text: Cosponsored the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2025 (H.R. 14), introduced Mar 5, 2025.
Cosponsored the Freedom to Vote Act (H.R. 11) in the 118th Congress, introduced Jul 18, 2023.

promises.why: He cosponsored the John Lewis Act in 2025 and the Freedom to Vote Act in 2023; neither had committee action after referral.

promises.promise: I will work to implement universal background checks and a ban on AR-15 assault weapons

actions.text: Cosponsored the Bipartisan Background Checks Act of 2025 (H.R. 18), introduced Jun 10, 2025.
Cosponsored the Assault Weapons Ban of 2025 (H.R. 3115), introduced Apr 30, 2025.
Sponsored the AMMO Act (H.R. 4227), requiring background checks and licensing for ammunition sales (Jun 2025).

promises.why: He cosponsored both bills and sponsored a related ammunition bill; none had committee action after referral.

promises.promise: I strongly support the Green New Deal

actions.text: Cosponsored the Green New Deal for Public Housing Act (H.R. 10063), introduced Aug 6, 2026.
Sponsored the Clean Shipping Act of 2025 (H.R. 4325), on emissions from large ships at U.S. ports (Jul 2025).

promises.why: His Green New Deal-branded bill in this Congress was only referred to committee; his Clean Shipping Act has had no committee action.

promises.promise: make it easier to join and form a union

actions.text: Cosponsored the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize Act of 2025 (H.R. 20), introduced Mar 5, 2025.

promises.why: He cosponsored the PRO Act, which was only referred to committee.

actions.text: Cosponsored the Child Care for Working Families Act (H.R. 4418), introduced Jul 15, 2025.
Cosponsored the Child Care for Every Community Act (H.R. 5658), introduced Sep 30, 2025.

promises.why: He cosponsored two child-care bills; neither had committee action after referral.

promises.promise: expand pathways to citizenship for undocumented residents

actions.text: Cosponsored the American Dream and Promise Act of 2025 (H.R. 1589), introduced Feb 26, 2025.
Sponsored the SHIELD Act (H.R. 3101), a grant program for immigrants' legal representation (Apr 2025).

promises.why: He cosponsored the American Dream and Promise Act; the bill has not advanced. His own SHIELD Act covers legal representation, not citizenship.

promises.promise: protect and expand eligibility and benefits for Medicaid, Social Security and Medicare

actions.text: {Vote} H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, in its final House vote. It passed {yea}–{nay}.
{Vote} the Do No Harm in Medicaid Act (H.R. 498). It passed {yea}–{nay}.
Said in Feb 2025 that Social Security and Medicare benefits “are off limits” to Elon Musk's access to Treasury payments.
Cosponsored the Social Security Fairness Act (H.R. 82), which became Public Law 118-273.

promises.why: He voted against the Medicaid and benefit cuts below and cosponsored a Social Security law, but no expansion bill he backs has advanced.

promises.promise: leader in pandemic prevention and biosafety and biosecurity planning

actions.text: Reintroduced the FLASH Act and SEWER Act (H.R. 767 and H.R. 766) in Jan 2025, on emergency medical purchasing and wastewater disease surveillance.

promises.why: He sponsored both bills; neither had committee action after referral.

promises.promise: fight to cancel student debt across America
promises.why: No bill or press release on student debt appears in his sponsored or cosponsored bills (congress.gov) or his press releases.

promises.promise: expand affordable and accessible housing across the United States

actions.text: Launched the Congressional YIMBY Caucus (Nov 2024).
Sponsored the People Over Parking Act of 2025 (H.R. 2710), to end mandatory parking minimums (Apr 2025).
{Vote} H.R. 6644, the Housing for the 21st Century Act (enacted as the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, Public Law 119-101). It passed {yea}–{nay}.

promises.why: He launched the YIMBY Caucus and voted for a bipartisan housing bill, but his own People Over Parking Act has had no committee action.
